checks_run: Complete submitted-file inventory and static review
Public suite against the learner starter baseline
Public and sealed suites against the sealed reference
Two clean reference builds and ELF/linkage/segment inspection
Benchmark harness execution and workload-size check
Strict manifest/provenance parsing and cross-binding checks
evidence: The documented learner baseline reproduced: the starter built, and its public run had 10 tests with the expected 8 failures and 2 passes.
The sealed reference passed all 10 public and 11 sealed test methods in an independent workspace copy.
The reference matched an independent requirements-based oracle in all 627 deterministic cases (seed 20260831; zero mismatches).
Two clean builds on the declared host produced identical SHA-256 d5832caaf9b900cc6ff78f6f0c53e4c31018fe6c6095a12be10475b547b99baf.
ELF inspection found x86-64 ELF64 EXEC, entry 0x4000e8, no dynamic section or undefined symbols, separate RX and RW load segments, and a non-executable stack.
The manifest honestly remains GENERATED/PARTIAL, requires independent validation, and sets productionized=false; the builder does not claim stronger labels.

The benchmark harness is not reproducible on the declared Python 3.6.8 host because time.perf_counter_ns is unavailable, and its default 10,000-operation program is 40,003 bytes despite the 4,095-byte accepted limit.
The submitted tree keeps evaluator-only reference code and hidden tests readable beside learner files; AGENTS.md prose is the only evidenced learner-view boundary.
Python test and benchmark subprocesses use timeouts and captured argv execution but do not create or clean up process groups.
Strict internal provenance bindings matched, no scanned credential pattern or special file was found, and the CANDIDATE content digest was unchanged after review.
limitations: The source catalog snapshot and linked Jonesforth content were unavailable in the restricted workspace, so source-commit, license evidence, and no-copy claims could not be compared with external originals.
No student-view exporter, access-control configuration, or transfer record was supplied; out-of-band filtering of sealed paths is therefore inconclusive.
strace was installed but ptrace was prohibited by the sandbox, so syscall traces and deterministic confirmation of individual short-read boundaries were unavailable.
qemu-x86_64 and valgrind were unavailable; execution was native x86-64 only.
git and rg were unavailable; find, grep, sha256sum, and direct file inspection were used instead.

The 627-case differential check was bounded sampling, not a fuzz campaign; no benchmark measurement, sanitizer, profiler, portability matrix, transfer verification, or production validation was completed.
